title: SuperHost, Cozy Duplex, 4 Beds, Near Downtown
description:
Charming mid-century brick duplex in Nashville’s safest neighborhood. 10 mins to Broadway, 2 mins to shops/restaurants, with a 1 min walk to the WeGo bus stop and a 4 min walk to a greenway trailhead. Perfect for up to 6 guests, with space for 8 if needed.  Includes a full kitchen and private backyard. Great for families, friends, solo travelers, concertgoers, business trips or road trips—book your Nashville escape!

The space
Built in 1949, this home is full of historic southern charm. Furnished with a king size bed in one bedroom, a full size bed in the other bedroom, a queen size airbed that can be set up in the living room, a twin size airbed that can be set up in the second bedroom or the living room, and a spacious sectional sofa. Fully useable kitchen with refrigerator, oven/stove, and washer & dryer, and a breakfast nook set for four. Complimentary coffee and tea is provided. Includes a private backyard with rocking chairs, picnic table and bistro table set. Don’t miss out on this gem—book now!

Guest access
Access to front yard, backyard, and the interior of the duplex, including use of washer and dryer with detergent and fabric softener sheets provided.

Other things to note
This house is a duplex with residents living in the other half of the house. Both sides are completely divided by a thick center wall with their own entrances and backyards.
